details.biography:
Bryan Searing is a visual effects producer. He began his career as a visual effects coordinator on major blockbusters, including Avatar (2009), Yogi Bear (2010), Hop (2011), Men in Black³ (2012), and Dawn of the Planet of the Apes (2014). He progressed into production leadership roles—serving as visual effects production manager on Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015)—before advancing to full producer credits on high-profile projects such as The Batman (2022), The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special (2022), Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 (2023), and Rebel Moon – Part Two: The Scargiver (2024), and Thunderbolts* (2025).

Bryan Searing is credited as one of the team nominated for Outstanding Visual Effects in a Photoreal Feature at the 21st Visual Effects Society Awards for The Batman, alongside Dan Lemmon, Russell Earl, Anders Langlands, and Dominic Tuohy.
